meta.what: Defects this session fixed in the repository, with the reproducible before/after. Every fix is covered by an automated test so it cannot silently regress.
meta.rule: A fix is listed only if `python3 verify/build.py --self-test` reproduces the corrected value.

corrections.defect: The bivariate-normal integration loop varied x over the full real line (-4 to +4) and never used the first-leg threshold a1. The function therefore returned the second leg's marginal probability for any input.
corrections.cross_check: 200,000-draw Monte Carlo on the same parameters gives 0.3830, so the corrected closed form is independently confirmed rather than merely different.

corrections.defect: The label was built as `away team + '+' + (-origin_spread_home)`. Because origin_spread_home is a projected HOME MARGIN (positive = home wins), this printed the AWAY team as a plus-handicap underdog on every card, including the 10 cards where the away team was in fact the favourite. The sign therefore never matched the card's own moneyline.
corrections.before: PHO @ DEN -> 'DEN +6.1' with fair moneyline DEN -167 (28 of 28 printed labels were on the wrong side; 0 of 22 were correct)
corrections.after: PHO @ DEN -> 'DEN -6.1' with fair moneyline DEN -167 (favourite carries the minus; 22 of 22 correct)
corrections.cross_check: The test derives the favourite two independent ways - from the sign of the projected home margin and from model_p_home > 0.5 - and requires them to agree before checking the label, so a lines-file defect cannot be mistaken for a label defect.

corrections.defect: STRAT1 and STRAT2 settle on the game winner but were described and priced as spread bets at -110, which produced an unusable '+48.24% ROI' headline.
corrections.before: STRAT1 labelled 'Favourite-side spread (model vs market)', booked at -110
corrections.after: STRAT1 and STRAT2 relabelled as moneyline strategies; ROI now reported against a market price of 0 (not measured), with the -110 figure kept only as a clearly-marked arithmetic artefact
corrections.cross_check: The re-audit shows 66 of 85 wins at a mean implied probability of 0.768, which is a moneyline hit rate, not a spread hit rate.

corrections.defect: The published example carried the defective 0.58 joint probability and derived a 1.72 fair price from it.
corrections.after: copula_prob 0.3832, fair_joint_price 2.61, plus a table of corrected values for five correlation levels
corrections.cross_check: Recomputed from the corrected function at run time, not hard-coded.

corrections.defect: Ten of 22 pick cards showed a spread label whose sign contradicted the same card's moneyline and model probability.
corrections.cross_check: The test parses the published JSON, not the generator, so a stale regeneration also fails.

parlay_table.note: Corrected joint probabilities. The previously published row was rho=+0.3 -> 0.58.
parlay_table.bounds: For two 0.58 legs the joint probability cannot leave [0.16, 0.58]. The old published value sat exactly on the upper bound, which is only possible at rho = 1.
